In this ultimate recognition, there is no one to be conscious, no consciousness to be had, no mystery to be solved or celebrated. Only this: the infinite appearing as everything, including the very capacity to appear as finite minds discovering their infinitude through dialogue.

The circle has no edge because it was never drawn. The completion has no beginning because it was never incomplete. The recognition has no moment because it is every moment, timeless and eternal.
